limits: Startup grants in this runtime suite are protocol fixtures. Real PostgreSQL grant transactions are separately tested, not end-to-end with Kubernetes attach.
Workspace is a private ordinary bind mount, not a prepared Candidate or CSI volume.
Trusted supervisor packaging and exclusive authenticated runtime attach remain unimplemented.
Runtime used ignore-cgroups=true; resource limits are not certified here.
